headline: Weathered Expanse Swings to Wardens; Strategic Ledger Stands 282-152
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has turned since our last edition: where Colonial colors flew over seven strongholds at the morning filing, the Wardens now hold five of its nine works, one lying wrecked, after fifty-eight recorded actions in the day, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk the busiest posts and the latest logged minutes before press. The wider ledger now reads 282 strategic works Colonial to 152 Warden, two in ruins, against 291-145 and none ruined at our last account. Stlican Shelf rivals it for turmoil, eleven actions inside the past two hours about Breaker Town, Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, the Wardens now holding six of nine, and the expanse carries the day's heaviest rolls, some 8,500 Colonial and 10,000 Warden casualties. Callahan's Passage, bloodiest of the shorter hours, has logged no base actions these two hours past, its pace slackening; Linn of Mercy's losses likewise cool. Viper Pit, Marban Hollow, Godcrofts and the Dead Lands, restless within the day, stand still these two hours. It is day 209; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
